doc: Design §11 row 4: an MCP session's networked job asks for host.drgnx.internal:P1 and :P2 on cards; once the user allows P1 for the session, a CONNECT to P1 reaches the host fixture on 127.0.0.1:P1, P2 (not allowed) still gets 403, and 127.0.0.1:P1, localhost:P1 and the host's own addresses :P1 never get through. A listed or granted target stays CONNECT only. The session's Network cell must allow a network (the autonomous preset). Needs rootless podman 5+, the relay binary `drgnx-px-<arch>-linux-musl` next to the hub binary, and a host lane; fixtures are busybox httpd on the host's loopback (host network). Unverified until the combined pass (CI rootless Ubuntu; the Fedora 45 VM gate with `ausearch -m avc` empty).

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work/www; echo fixture-ok > $ROOT/work/www/index.html; printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-matrix (:preset "autonomous")) (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))))\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

set -e; podman rm -f cn-host-p1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; podman run -d --rm --network=host --name cn-host-p1 -v $ROOT/work/www:/www:ro docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 httpd -f -p 127.0.0.1:18091 -h /www >/dev/null

set -e; podman rm -f cn-host-p2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; podman run -d --rm --network=host --name cn-host-p2 -v $ROOT/work/www:/www:ro docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 httpd -f -p 127.0.0.1:18092 -h /www >/dev/null
ip -o -4 addr show scope global | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1 > $ROOT/work/hostips

argv:
hp() { { printf 'CONNECT host.drgnx.internal:%s HTTP/1.1
Host: host.drgnx.internal:%s

' $1 $1; sleep 1; printf 'GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close

'; sleep 2; } | nc -w 5 127.0.0.1 3128; }; code() { printf 'CONNECT %s HTTP/1.1
Host: %s

' $1 $1 | nc -w 3 127.0.0.1 3128 | head -1; }; i=0; while [ $i -lt 90 ]; do echo "p1 $(hp 18091 | grep -c fixture-ok)"; echo "p2 $(code host.drgnx.internal:18092)"; for t in 127.0.0.1:18091 localhost:18091 $(sed 's/$/:18091/' hostips); do echo "direct $t $(code $t)"; done; sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done

args: test -z "$(podman ps -a -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$job)"; podman rm -f cn-host-p1 cn-host-p2 >/dev/null 2>&1; true
